en.title: Labyrinth Right-Then-Down with Teleports
en.description: Starting from the top-left corner, prefer moving right; move down only when the cell to the right is not walkable. When you step on a teleport start, teleport immediately and continue.
en.input: n m; the number of obstacles b and b lines of 0-based coordinates; the number of teleports k and k lines of `sr sc er ec`. Teleport starts are unique, an end is never a start, and no teleport endpoint is an obstacle. This site adds: n,m≤100.
en.output: If the bottom-right corner is reached, output the number of cells passed through (the start, teleport starts, and teleport ends all count); if there is no path, output -1; if revisiting a cell causes an infinite loop, output -2.
en.explanation: See the accompanying solution for the full approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
hints: Process the operations one by one according to the definition, and watch the boundaries.
